title: KCP space_show result (DESIGN.md §10.2, §11.6.1 read family)
description: CommandResult.result payload for space_show (§11.2 ok arm; the envelope's revision/event_cursor members live outside this payload). The visible Space projection (gap note KG4).

displayName.description: Display name bounded by the §11.8 cap of 256 Unicode scalar values, length-bounded again at admission.

identifier.description: Opaque identifier, at most 128 bytes (§11.8); visible-ASCII alphabet is a K0 extraction decision (spec/schemas/README.md).

safeNonNegativeInteger.description: I-JSON safe integer (§11.8 rejects unsafe integers).

space.description: Space projection, field names verbatim from the §10.2 record shape (gap note KG4).

spaceStatus.description: Closed Space.status enum, verbatim §10.2 (§11.8: closed); transitions are the typed space_freeze/reopen/archive operations.

spaceVisibility.description: Closed Space.visibility enum, verbatim §10.2 (§11.8: closed). restricted additionally requires an active SpaceParticipant (§10.2).

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 date-time (recorded K0 extraction decision, spec/schemas/README.md item 7); format: date-time additionally requires semantic calendar validity (R0 KENV-05).
